summary.overview: The project exposes useful validation and CI surfaces, but its project agent context is only a framework stub and its sole project Skill is excluded from version control. The session evidence contains no edited episode, so current-task behavior and delivery outcomes remain insufficiently observed.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: The project rule file points to bundled Next.js guidance but provides no project-specific operating map, and no edited episode was available to verify application.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Scripts and CI provide supported execution surfaces, but the only project Skill is not versioned and is therefore unavailable in a clean checkout.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: The workspace exposes typecheck, lint, test, and build checks, but no edited episode was available to show focused validation and revalidation after repair.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: CI wiring offers a delivery gate, but no delivery or recovery outcome was observed, so acceptance confidence remains low.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: No comparable later window or intervention comparison is available; loop effectiveness and asset promotion are not evaluated.

findings.title: Task starts without a project-specific context map
findings.reason: The sole project rule file only points agents to bundled Next.js guidance. A fresh checkout therefore leaves the project’s own commands, acceptance boundaries, and high-risk change routes to be rediscovered from source history. No comparable edited episode was available to prove that agents apply the missing context.
expectedOutput: Give each recurring task a project-owned starting point and an executable validation route.
findings.aiFixPrompt: Expand AGENTS.md with a concise project map: supported commands, primary architecture boundaries, validation expectations, and the few high-risk changes that require review. Keep framework-specific details out unless they differ from the installed Next.js version. Verify by opening the file in a clean checkout and checking that every named route maps to an existing project script, workflow, or owner file.

findings.title: The project skill is absent from a clean checkout
findings.reason: The only discovered project Skill is stored below a directory ignored by the project. Because the Skill is not tracked, a fresh checkout receives neither the design workflow nor a durable route for the agent to invoke it. The scan found no second supported project Skill.
expectedOutput: Make the project design workflow available in a clean checkout without publishing local secrets or tool state.
findings.aiFixPrompt: Version the project Skill in the project’s configured Skill route, then update .gitignore so only genuinely local agent artifacts remain ignored. Verify with a clean temporary checkout that the Skill inventory reports the project Skill and that its required local assets are present without exposing secrets or tool-state files.
